svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: PF1550 pinout, HVQFN-40
svg.desc: Pinout of the PF1550 in HVQFN-40, top view: 40 pins and an exposed pad, each with its name, its electrical type as a colour and the driver hook that uses it.
svg.text: Top view, pin 1 marked. Colour is the pin's electrical type; the mono text outside is the port hook the driver uses for it. Datasheet: 4.1 Pinning, p. 7.
